shadowing_prompts.title: Introduce Yourself (O'zingizni tanishtiring)
shadowing_prompts.text: Hello, my name is Alex. I am twenty-two years old and I live in Tashkent. In my free time, I really enjoy learning English and reading books.
shadowing_prompts.instructions_uz: Ushbu matnni baland ovozda, so'zlarni aniq talaffuz qilgan holda o'qing va ovozli xabar (voice message) yuboring.

shadowing_prompts.title: My Favorite Weekend Activity (Dam olish kuni)
shadowing_prompts.text: Every Saturday morning, I like to wake up early and go for a refreshing run in the nearby park. Fresh air clears my mind and energizes me for the entire day.
shadowing_prompts.instructions_uz: Ohang va to'xtamlarga e'tibor bering. Ovozli xabar yozib jo'nating.

shadowing_prompts.title: The Power of Lifelong Learning (Doimiy o'rganish)
shadowing_prompts.text: Learning a new language is not just about memorizing words; it expands your horizons, introduces you to diverse cultures, and unlocks unprecedented opportunities.
shadowing_prompts.instructions_uz: Ushbu fikrni ravon va ishonch bilan talaffuz qilib, botga ovozli xabar qilib yuboring.

shadowing_prompts.title: Technological Advancements & Society (Texnologiya va jamiyat)
shadowing_prompts.text: Artificial intelligence is fundamentally revolutionizing the landscape of modern education, empowering autonomous learners to access personalized tutoring anytime, anywhere.
shadowing_prompts.instructions_uz: Murakkab so'zlar urg'usi va intonatsiyasiga e'tibor berib, ovozli xabar yozing.

free_speech_prompts.topic: Why do you want to learn English?
free_speech_prompts.topic_uz: Nima uchun ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchisiz va bu til sizning hayotingizni qanday o'zgartiradi?
free_speech_prompts.tips_uz: Kamida 20-40 soniya gapiring. Maqsadingiz, rejalaringiz haqida so'zlab bering.

free_speech_prompts.topic: Describe your hometown or current city.
free_speech_prompts.topic_uz: O'z ona shahringiz yoki hozir yashayotgan shahringizni tasvirlab bering.
free_speech_prompts.tips_uz: Shaharning qaysi jihatlari sizga yoqishi yoki yoqmasligi haqida 30-50 soniya gapiring.

free_speech_prompts.topic: What is one big dream you want to achieve in the next 3 years?
free_speech_prompts.topic_uz: Kelgusi 3 yil ichida amalga oshirmoqchi bo'lgan eng katta orzuingiz nima?
free_speech_prompts.tips_uz: Rejalaringiz, nima sababdan bu orzu muhimligi va unga qanday erishishingizni tushuntiring.
